name: How does material selection affect the overall cost of a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does material selection affect the overall cost of a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Material selection significantly influences the overall cost of a whole-home remodel. High-end finishes, custom cabinetry, and premium flooring options naturally increase the investment compared to standard selections. However, AKN Design Group employs value engineering strategies during the design phase to optimize material choices without compromising quality or your design vision. We provide upfront estimates and clear communication regarding material costs, ensuring transparency and alignment with your project budget while still achieving the desired aesthetic and long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Material selection heavily impacts whole-home remodel costs; high-end choices increase investment. We use value engineering to optimize selections and ensure cost transparency.
